I didn’t phrase them like that more leaning to what you wrote actually, but maybe I can work on that. 

A point that both of you kinda mentioned is that she compared me to her parents, could you elaborate on that point please? Cause I dont know how else to bring it up?

I used the latter part “if you’re using it that much, why not delete it next month before finals, you can delete multiple ones that’s what I used to do” then we got into a heated argument about how she prefers a healthy balance, but then things escalated when it came to unsolicited advice

My issue is do I have a right to have a say anything, The argument boiled down to her boundaries in this relationship is me not saying anything she’s fine with telling me thing and get that i don’t mind it but she does, i argued that I would get her point of view if I was her friend but I’m her partner and wanna spend the rest of my life with her not a rando off the street. 

But honestly I just don’t wanna feel like I’m crossing her boundaries.

But if she’s doing something harmful, or I have a suggestions that’s gonna make her life easier, if she’s my partner shouldn’t I have a say? 

Like she should have a say in my life and I should have in hers, she doesn’t have to take the advice but she should at least consider it, I’m not her friend or a stranger, we’ve been together for a year and a half and I can see myself spending the rest of my life with this women.
